notes: Draft configuration: Pre-extension course follows the full northern bend, central return and southern hairpin using the pinned January 2018 raceways. Motorsport UK documents the later extension from 852 to 1140 m. The independently mapped historic route measures 850.4 m; current extension branches are excluded. Historical alignment and direction remain draft. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 850.4 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.

Estimated constant-width corridor: width is stored in track.json; inner, outer and ideal lines are calculated in the browser from the mapped trace. Local widening and earlier boundary corrections are not retained by this approximation.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 17 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the mapped trace, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.
